svg.aria-label: The push p is subtracted from both of CO3's two noise predictions, which lowers the guided prediction by p before the next sampler step.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Where the push enters our sampler's noise prediction
What the existing push code does
On CO3's main call only, the batch of two, it subtracts p from both entries.
The push length is capped at c times the length of the guided prediction.
A random direction of matched length is the control.
Zero strength must reproduce the plain sampler.
The checker in that code is swapped for S right minus S wrong.
Its gradient g is taken at the latent.
The step W3 decides the strength, cap and window.
No sentence score has been run on our pictures.
steps W2 and W3 measure whether it reads or steers
